visual_description: A series of four large, foldable solar panels laid out on a rocky slope. The panels have a matte, dark-blue 'shingled' cell pattern to reduce glare. Heavy-duty kickstands hold them at a 45-degree angle toward the sun. Thick, UV-resistant cables lead from the panels into a nearby shade tent.

constraints.material: Monocrystalline silicon cells; rugged ETFE plastic coating; reinforced nylon edges.
constraints.logic: Provides silent, infinite energy during the day to charge batteries for the Night Dig.
